what_happened: Node.js, Next.js and Tailwind CSS families were left with eol=null because their endoflife.date product ids (nodejs, nextjs, tailwind-css) differ from their package names (node, next, tailwindcss).
rule: Never infer an eol id from a package name. Match endoflife.date products by package URL (purl) instead.
guard: tests/corpus.test.ts > no family with eol=null has an endoflife.date product whose package URL maps to one of its members
